description: Nirlon Limited engages in the development and management of an industrial/information technology park. The company's primary business activity is the development, management, and operation of Nirlon Knowledge Park (NKP), an approximately 23-acre campus located in Goregaon (East), Mumbai. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is based in Mumbai, India. Nirlon Limited operates as a subsidiary of Reco Berry Private Limited.
